text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-482 triggered for routing-fallback-errors (sev2)
Alice H: noticing a stream of 500s from multiple Dedicated tenants, started ~03:06 UTC
Alice H: dashboards showing sudden spike in hosted->dedicated handoffs, traffic rate normal though
Ben K: I'm on pager, joining now, can someone paste the failing log lines?
Carla M: logs show model variant mismatch on fallback path:
Carla M: ```
2026-03-15T03:06:12Z ERROR router: fallback selected incompatible-quantized-v2 for model redwood-7b
2026-03-15T03:06:12Z WARN router: tenant t-87ff tried hosted, routed to dedicated pool-d-4
2026-03-15T03:06:14Z ERROR inference: session init failed: kv-cache mismatch
```
Dinesh P: pinging infra - looks like a recent policy push to smart-routing-service at 03:05 UTC changed tier priorities
Dinesh P: that push also introduced a new "prefer-region-capacity" rule that can force region fallback before model-compat check
Eve S: customers complaining via support — one reported incorrect completions and higher latency, tag: acct:t-87ff and acct:t-11a2
Ben K: okay, immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause smart-routing policy 2) revert last policy commit 3) drain the affected dedicated pool 4) open customer comms draft
Carla M: I can revert the policy. patch id: sr-policy@2026-03-15-0305 (PR#8421). Reverting now.
Carla M: ```bash
cictl policies rollback sr-policy@2026-03-15-0305 || true
```
incident-bot: Policy rollback deployed to canary and main, status: success
Alice H: traffic still showing some misrouted requests - maybe cached routing decisions in routers/kvs
Dinesh P: yes routers have a 30s sticky cache for tenant routing. We'll need to purge caches to fully stop the misroutes
Dinesh P: running purge: ```bash
redis-cli -h router-cache-01 FLUSHKEYS tenant:*:sr
```
Ben K: draining pool-d-4 from LB to avoid new sessions: ```bash
kubectl cordon node-pool-d-4 && kubectl scale deployment pool-d-4 --replicas=0
```
Eve S: can we rate-limit fallbacks while caches flush? customers still see 502s
Alice H: yes, applying temporary quota override to hosted tier to prefer hosted unless explicit dedicated pin
Carla M: applied quota override, policy now prefers hosted for tenants without dedicated binding.
pagerduty: Ben K acknowledged the incident at 03:10 UTC
Ben K: I'm taking full ownership of the incident. Carla, Dinesh, please standby for handoff in 20m
Carla M: noted. I'll watch the error-rate graph and be ready to redeploy a hotfix if needed
Dinesh P: infra: noticed region fallback loop — some routers bouncing between us-east and us-west because region-capacity rule returned alternating candidates
Dinesh P: root cause: a tie-breaker bug in smart-routing that uses last-seen-load instead of stable hash for equal scores
Alice H: good catch, that explains the oscillation; oscillation increased pressure on dedicated pools causing OOMs and evictions
Ben K: action: block region-fallback policy until tie-breaker fix shipped. Carla, can you patch to short-circuit region fallback?
Carla M: creating hotfix PR to bypass region-capacity when model_variant compatibility fails. PR#8427
Carla M: patch diff snippet: ```diff
- if (candidate.score == best) considerRegionFallback();
+ if (!isModelCompatible(candidate) || candidate.score == best) continue;
```
incident-bot: Hotfix PR#8427 merged to hotfix branch, deploying to canary
Eve S: support: opening status page and emailing affected tenants (t-87ff, t-11a2, t-3c88) with one-line summary and ETA
Alice H: customer impact estimate: ~12 tenants impacted, 30-120s increased latency, ~4 tenants saw 5xxs for some requests
Ben K: good. timeline for full remediation? Carla/Dinesh?
Carla M: canary hotfix looks good, no new 500s in canary region for 10m. Rolling to prod now.
Dinesh P: purged router caches globally at 03:23 UTC to remove sticky bad decisions.
Ben K: monitoring graphs show error rate back to baseline at 03:27 UTC. Latency stabilized by 03:30 UTC
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-482 acknowledged resolved by Ben K at 03:31 UTC (notified PagerDuty)
Ben K: postmortem notes to write: misconfigured routing policy shipped without model-compatibility guard + tie-breaker bug causing region oscillation + sticky caches extended impact window.
Alice H: mitigations to include in postmortem: 1) add unit test to prevent policy pushes that skip model compatibility 2) remove sticky cache reliance for 30s when policy changes 3) add circuit-breaker to avoid region oscillation under equal scores 4) alerts for unexpected hosted->dedicated handoff rate > 2x baseline
Carla M: I'll own the postmortem draft and include timeline + config diffs. Ben, please review.
Ben K: will review. Thanks everyone for quick ops. :thumbsup:
Eve S: I'll follow up with support comms and the customer RCA note once postmortem lands
Alice H: closing thread, leaving incident channel for follow-ups.
